label: I q.77 a.6 co. and ad 2–3 — Qualified active causality of the subject for its proper accident
locator: I q.77 a.6 co. and ad 2–3
interpretation: The body discusses proper accidents in explaining how the powers of the soul flow from its essence, with the soul alone receiving some powers and the composite receiving others. Ad 2 qualifies the subject’s active causality, and ad 3 explains the emanation as natural resultance without change.
attribution: The passage states that the subject is productive of its proper accident insofar as it is actual and receptive insofar as it is potential, with causality active in a qualified sense and natural resultance without change, which is the premise.
